# Leonardt Lauenstein

> Email engineer, design engineer, and front-end developer based in Porto, Portugal.

Leonardt Lauenstein builds lifecycle email systems, design-to-production UI, and AI-assisted production pipelines. Seven years across design and front-end. Most recently Email Front-End Developer at Prezi (Jun 2024 – Jun 2026). Previously growth front-end and design at Pier and Hakkoda.
